edge_thesis: Mechanism: with a next-open fill and same-bar double-touch rule, the tradable edge is not prediction but structure - take only trend-continuation exposure in assets with persistent institutional flows (US large-cap beta, gold central-bank bid, BTC post-halving supply squeeze), bracket each with stops sized wider than one typical bar range so a single bar can never touch both TP and SL, and let stop distance define risk so R stays >=1.5 on every branch. The other side is the forced seller: deleveraging funds, options dealers hedging gamma, and weak-hand panic sellers who supply entries on dips. Avoids FX and single names where fill-price uncertainty would break bracket geometry, and uses one NAV-priced short-duration bond fund as a drawdown-free net-positive placeholder.
self_disclosed_staleness: If the market has run since my last data, the fill lands far above my last-known ~$100k for BTC, collapsing R toward 0.3 and putting TP 124k at risk of being below the actual tape. Gold could be near or above $3,600, leaving only a sliver of R.

picks.why: US large-cap uptrend continuation; stop ~7% below fill zone, outside one week of noise, TP +11% for ~1.8R.
Strongest persistent macro trend (central-bank accumulation); trend drift does the work, stop is a disaster line, not a noise line.
Post-halving supply squeeze trend; 24/7 tape means fast TP resolution, and a 38k total bracket can never be spanned by one bar.
Low-vol quality compounding as the book ballast; high probability of net-positive close for tie-break with capped ~-1R tail.
NAV-priced short-duration bond fund: near-certain small positive accrual, zero drawdown contribution, pads net-positive count.
